scope: Operator measurement correction and read-only verification; no actuation or calibration changes
conclusion: The 9 V telemetry is consistent with the corrected 9.5 V physical measurement at integer-volt resolution. The earlier claimed analog offset at zero bus is not established by those measurements.
remaining_limitations: This single low-voltage measurement does not certify accuracy across the whole bus range.
The physical origin of bus voltage with auxiliary supply only is not isolated by this comparison.
A charged DC bus is not a zero-bus condition, regardless of the mains input being disconnected.
No motor start or energized inverter acceptance is claimed.
